scope_note: Topic IDs are public community posts on www.gushi.in. The adjacent 量化选股 link to i.gushi.in and its strategy-pick API are outside this corpus. Listing title screening is not a full-text verdict.

assessments.title: 预告一下屌炸天的玩具～ 【换种方式实现量化交易】
assessments.source_method: Announcement for an automated trading tool; not a backtest validation method.
assessments.reason: The post concerns execution tooling, not how to establish backtest validity; no engine integration is inferred.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Only relevant to a separately scoped execution-interface review.

assessments.title: 主力是什么 ？怎么避免被套以及最佳买点是什么？一篇文章全讲完
assessments.source_method: Chart-pattern and entry-point advice.
assessments.reason: This is strategy content rather than a reusable backtest-agent control; a prior local study exists and is not re-adopted as methodology.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Any individual signal would need a separate frozen, point-in-time replication.

assessments.title: 如图，请教下这个策略具体是啥，回测数据如何？
assessments.reason: The main post is an image with no extractable text in the public HTML; the pictured strategy and metrics were not decoded or independently inspected.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Requires the image content and underlying rule/data before assessment.

assessments.title: 简单粗暴的可执行策略（黄金两点半 · 收盘买 · T+1 收盘卖）
assessments.source_method: Screen around 14:30, inspect price near 14:55, buy candidates in a stated gain band, then sell on T+1 near the closing call auction.
assessments.reason: The exact signal timestamp, price observation/fill, closing-auction order timing, partial fills, and raw trades are not specified sufficiently to accept the posted summary metrics.
assessments.applicability_conditions: A separate experiment needs intraday/auction data, predeclared order timestamps, fill/queue assumptions, costs, and a frozen date split.
assessments.experiment_plan: Freeze a signal/order timeline first; compare executable order-time fills with a daily-bar upper bound; do not use as production logic.

assessments.title: 仅站内分享：我当前使用的自动交易因子
assessments.source_method: Score threshold, price/market-cap/turnover filters, then an opening-price step-up order and a next-session closing-auction exit.
assessments.reason: No sample, point-in-time definition of the score, exchange-arrival timestamp, rejected/partial-fill ledger, or benchmark is supplied.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Candidate only if score availability precedes the order, order time and fill mechanics are modeled, and all costs are explicit.
assessments.experiment_plan: Write a frozen rule manifest, time-of-availability table, and blind-order fill model before local replay; compare against a same-universe baseline.

assessments.title: T+1策略实盘-20260921
assessments.reason: A short forum trade log is not an independently verified account statement or full fill ledger; it cannot establish strategy expectancy.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Use only as anecdotal execution context; quantitative inference requires complete dated holdings/fills/costs.

assessments.title: 没有人来买十点半策略吗？谁来搞个十点半的回测
assessments.reason: The post requests someone to backtest a strategy but does not state a reproducible strategy rule or a validation method.
assessments.applicability_conditions: A later rule specification would be a new candidate source.

assessments.title: T+1策略实盘-20290922
assessments.reason: The title embeds 20290922 while the post body and listing indicate 2026-09-22; the short trade log lacks a full account/fill export.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Resolve the date discrepancy and obtain point-in-time fills before using as evidence.

assessments.title: T+1策略实盘-20260923
assessments.reason: A brief self-reported daily trade note has no independently verifiable account/fill history or cost reconciliation.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Anecdote only; no strategy performance inference.

assessments.title: T+1策略实盘-20260924
assessments.reason: The post reports a daily result and partial account access, but does not expose the complete account/fill ledger needed for independent reconciliation.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Anecdote only; resolve listed date and full trade/cost records before statistical use.

assessments.title: 开箱即用的自动化交易API开源发布，无券商门槛，全自动下单撤单，做个无情的交易机器
assessments.reason: This is an execution API/tool release, not a backtest research method; tool claims are not evidence of strategy validity.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Only relevant to separately authorized execution integration work.

assessments.title: 分享一个牛来策略信号浏览器插件：打开网页就能筛股（v0.7.0）
assessments.reason: A browser signal-display plugin is not an evaluation procedure, and displayed picks do not substantiate returns.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Do not treat UI output as a backtest or independent source of time series.

assessments.title: 买卖股票是否都收手续费？一文看懂 A 股全部交易成本
assessments.source_method: Model commissions, transfer fees, sell-side tax, minimum commissions, and the effect of turnover on net returns.
assessments.reason: The article's quoted fee/tax rates and broker examples are not verified as current or universal; the transferable idea is cost decomposition, not its numbers.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Use the actual account schedule, asset class, date-valid taxes, minimum charge, and direction-specific fees in the execution spec.
assessments.experiment_plan: Unit-test per-side fee floors and compare gross/net returns with the account-specific schedule; retain the source figures only as unverified examples.

assessments.title: 股票前复权、不复权是什么？实操怎么选
assessments.source_method: Distinguish unadjusted, forward-adjusted, and backward-adjusted price series; keep signal and execution bases consistent.
assessments.reason: The post's recommendation to use forward-adjusted data by default is not a point-in-time guarantee; a moving adjustment anchor can revise historical values.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Record vendor, adjustment basis/anchor, corporate-action handling, and executable raw-price basis; do not use a current adjusted series as historical fills without proving invariance.
assessments.experiment_plan: Add an adjustment-anchor regression comparing frozen historical features/signals before and after later corporate-action updates; report any changed rows.

assessments.title: 回测中的未来函数排查清单：十分钟自检
assessments.source_method: Organize look-ahead review across indicator repainting, bar/data availability, universe/selection timing, execution/signal revision, and sample/parameter/cost leakage.
assessments.reason: Adopt only the audit dimensions and the requirement to prove detector sensitivity; do not adopt the post's unsourced prevalence claim or its blanket rule that every emitted signal can never change.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Map each feature to its earliest available timestamp; distinguish a T-close signal executed at T+1 from an intraday decision using an unclosed bar; assess only the audited strategy/window and disclose probe limits.

assessments.title: 回测中的未来函数排查清单：十分钟自检
assessments.reason: The statement that 90% of popular indicators contain future functions has no cited sample or reproducible measurement; it is not accepted as a fact.
assessments.applicability_conditions: No general prevalence claim is used by the agent.

assessments.title: 从模拟盘到实盘：上线前必须完成的 12 项检查
assessments.source_method: Pre-release checklist covers fixed rules, position/risk limits, costs/slippage, regime applicability, and post-trade records.
assessments.reason: The list mixes testable execution controls with subjective psychology advice and provides no study validating the claimed benefit of passing all 12 items.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Only measurable items can become gates; psychological guidance is not treated as backtest evidence.
assessments.experiment_plan: Map each measurable item to an existing engine/spec assertion; add only a missing assertion with a positive and negative fixture, leaving trade signals unchanged.

assessments.title: 5000只主升浪因子浓缩成一个公式，这个选股逻辑凭什么这么准？
assessments.source_method: Moving-average compression, trend ordering, volume expansion, and bounded daily return as a candidate setup.
assessments.reason: The title and formula do not provide a point-in-time universe, sample protocol, costs, benchmark, or independent evidence for the accuracy claim.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Treat only as a candidate rule; a separate experiment must freeze formula semantics and executable timing.
assessments.experiment_plan: Transcribe the formula, unit-test each clause and information timestamp, preregister train/used-OOS/holdout windows, then replay with costs and controls.

assessments.title: 攻守兼备，高胜率右侧交易指标源码！
assessments.source_method: Momentum reversal plus weighted-channel breakout and proposed staged exits/time stop.
assessments.reason: The post gives no defined sample, fills, denominator for win rate, baseline, or independent replay; its risk/exit suggestions are not established results.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Any rule must be translated into the declared engine, with event ordering and fill feasibility proven.
assessments.experiment_plan: Pre-register a single literal translation, test same-bar controls and costs, and report all trades plus a sealed holdout before considering promotion.

assessments.title: 股票除权除息价格计算公式详解
assessments.reason: A corporate-action reference is not itself a backtest-agent method; tax details are time-sensitive and no external authoritative schedule was checked in this task.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Use only in a separately sourced, date-specific corporate-action/data-contract check.

assessments.title: 我完成了360度无死角的量化交易系统
assessments.reason: The article describes a large indicator panel and estimated money-flow proxy but provides no executable backtest, result matrix, point-in-time fundamentals, or validated signal timestamps.
assessments.applicability_conditions: No formula or performance claim is imported into the production agent.

assessments.title: 仓位管理，止盈止损体系详细解析
assessments.reason: General position/exit advice without a falsifiable rule and experiment; portfolio parameters are not changed from prose alone.
assessments.applicability_conditions: A defined sizing or exit hypothesis belongs in a separately preregistered portfolio test.

assessments.title: A股 9:15—9:30 集合竞价交易规则详解
assessments.reason: The post is a secondary explanation; the repository already uses ADR-0004/engine session rules as the execution source of truth. Its blanket claim that extreme limit-price orders ensure a fill is not adopted.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Use repository session/fill implementation and exchange-sourced rules; forum prose is not an execution contract.

assessments.title: 量化顶底源码指标无未来
assessments.reason: The formula text is readable but the '无未来' title claim is not proven by appearance of REF-only operators; platform function semantics, bar timing, warm-up and actual fills were not replayed.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Treat as an unvalidated signal candidate; a local syntax/causality audit would be required before any claim.

assessments.title: 精确度99的主力操盘指标源码
assessments.reason: '99% accuracy' has no operational metric definition, sample denominator, test window, class balance, costs, or independent output.
assessments.applicability_conditions: No accuracy figure is accepted or repeated as a result.

assessments.title: T+1策略实盘-20260928
assessments.reason: A short diary entry lacks a complete externally verifiable holdings/fills/cost ledger and is not a backtest.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Anecdote only; do not estimate expectancy from the posted snapshot.

assessments.title: 🌟 T+1 闪电策略历史收益总结
assessments.source_method: A fixed-rule, daily top-two T+1 candidate design with stated price/volume/turnover/lot/cost/fill assumptions.
assessments.reason: The post says 3,700,710 combinations were compared over 2025-08-08–2026-09-24 and the same period supplied the winning configuration; 'fixed after search' does not make that period an untouched holdout. No raw trade series or preregistration is provided.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Do not use its reported returns; if re-tested, lock one exact rule and treat the forum period as consumed selection data.
assessments.experiment_plan: Preregister a literal rule and local point-in-time universe; freeze all parameters before a later sealed holdout, preserve every trial, and run DSR/PBO/multiple-testing audit with costs.

assessments.title: 🌟 T+1 闪电策略历史收益总结
assessments.reason: Monthly tables, ending assets, drawdown and same-thread alternatives are author-reported; underlying price universe, code, daily fills and account ledger are not supplied for independent reconciliation.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Cite as a post claim only, never as a verified backtest result.

assessments.title: 🌟竞价阿尔法策略 一年期收益曲线
assessments.source_method: Filter/rank by the actual opening rise and then buy at that same opening price.
assessments.reason: The open-price feature is only known at the opening event while the fill is also assigned to that event; this is same-bar information/fill. The current rule is not executable under the repository's pre-open blind-order policy.
assessments.applicability_conditions: A separately redesigned pre-open rule could be evaluated, but it would not be a reproduction of this same-open rule.

assessments.title: 🌟竞价阿尔法策略 一年期收益曲线
assessments.reason: The +183.95%/+716.99% return curves are posted figures without raw orders, point-in-time candidate list, full cost schedule or independent ledger; the author also warns that the sample was selected for favorable historical behavior.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Do not treat posted curve as an expected return or evidence of a valid strategy.

assessments.title: T+1策略实盘-20260929
assessments.reason: Single-day self-reported position note; no complete account, execution costs or benchmark data.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Anecdote only.

assessments.title: 止损不是数字，是买入理由的失效点——一次爆仓复盘后的顿悟
assessments.source_method: Define an exit when the stated entry thesis is invalidated rather than copying a universal fixed percentage.
assessments.reason: This is a personal anecdote with two examples, not an out-of-sample comparison; thesis invalidation must be translated into an objective, timestamped rule.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Do not alter an existing stop; test a clearly coded rule against the frozen baseline with identical costs and sample windows.
assessments.experiment_plan: Pre-register a falsifiable thesis-invalidation rule, define available-at time, test positive/negative controls and all exits, then evaluate only on a sealed holdout.

assessments.title: 分享一个我常用的盘后复盘清单（可执行版）
assessments.source_method: Record market context, re-check the entry thesis, write next-session scenarios, and keep a mistake log.
assessments.reason: This is one user's workflow and reports a subjective trading-frequency change; it is not evidence of alpha or a backtest pass criterion.
assessments.applicability_conditions: Only the record-keeping idea may be tested as a report template; it must not change signals or be cited as profitability evidence.
assessments.experiment_plan: Trial a structured deviation/assumption log on shadow research runs and measure whether it improves traceability, not returns.

assessments.title: 当前这个看到策略以后 能持续跟踪吗
assessments.source_method: 回复提出按开盘买入，并分别测次日开盘/收盘退出，排除涨跌停无法买入样本。
assessments.reason: 这是回复中的个人口径，不是原始全量回测或共同结论；若剔除锁板不披露拒绝数，会产生选择偏差。
assessments.applicability_conditions: 用同一预注册候选分别评估 T+1 开盘卖与收盘卖，列出锁板/停牌拒单率、费用和逐笔差异，不按事后最优退出法挑选。
assessments.experiment_plan: 只在信号和价格数据点时可用、成交日可成交性可检查时；两种 exit 均视为独立试验。

assessments.title: 从日常决策看懂个人量化底层逻辑 做量化最容易踩的误区
assessments.source_method: 主张有效方法应跨时间稳定、分组收益单调，且警惕参数过拟合、漏计滑点与手续费。
assessments.reason: 帖子没有给出用于这些结论的源数据、组别定义或实验结果；只能转成诊断假设。
assessments.applicability_conditions: 对预先声明的排序/评分模型输出逐年与分组读数；预先冻结分组、统计口径与试验数，再交过拟合审计。
assessments.experiment_plan: 分组单调性只适用于有排序/分数的策略，不适用于所有规则；不改变交易信号。

assessments.title: 主力控盘度指标

assessments.applicability_conditions: 需分别检查每个输出线/标记的最早可用时点与重绘行为。
